_comment: Example of the product_announcement section of config.json. Setup (SKILL.md) and the voice lookup (references/voice.md) write it after the user confirms. Every value is a placeholder and yours to replace. null voice = the skill's built-in style. Don't commit a real config to a shared repo.

setup._comment: status_values replaces the default set (GA, Open Beta, Closed Beta, EA, Coming Soon) when present.

glossary._comment: allowed_names are verified names the mechanical check skips (SKILL.md Step 2), for example a term like COVID-19 that looks like a ticket key.
allowed_names: <verified name the check should skip, exact spelling>

voice._comment: source: config, skill, memory, instructions, or pasted. source_skill names an installed voice or style skill (a pointer, never its content); source_refs lists memory or instruction files or doc titles. The voice sets tone and word choice only; the skill's hard rules always win.
voice.summary: <two to four lines: how your brand sounds>
set_aside: <voice rule the hard rules override, for example: em dashes>
